subject: English
title: English 3 (PECTAA, SNC 2020)
questions: Which word has the soft sound of 'c' (like 's')?
In 'city' the letter c sounds like s. In cat, cap and can it sounds like k.
Which word has the soft sound of 'g' (like 'j')?
In 'giant' the letter g sounds like j.
Which word begins with the consonant cluster 'sh'?
'Ship' begins with sh. Two letters joined to make one sound make a consonant cluster.
Which word ends with the consonant cluster 'st'?
'Dust' ends with st; stamp and stick begin with it.
Which of these is a proper noun?
A proper noun is the name of a particular person, place or thing and begins with a capital letter.
Which of these letters is a vowel?
The vowels are a, e, i, o and u. All other letters are consonants.
Which word has a long vowel sound?
In 'boat' the vowel says its own name (oa). Hit, bed and box have short vowel sounds.
Which word has a short vowel sound?
A vowel in the middle of a short word like 'cat' is usually short.

The poem says: 'You are the life of all things' — life on earth depends on the sun.

A conjunction joins words or sentences, like and, but, or, because.
